theme: Xử lý phàn nàn của khách

vocab.meaning_vi: chuyển khiếu nại lên cấp cao hơn
vocab.example: If we can't resolve it, we'll escalate the complaint to the manager.
vocab.example_vi: Nếu không giải quyết được, chúng tôi sẽ chuyển khiếu nại lên cấp quản lý.

vocab.example: Let's find the root cause before we respond to the client.
vocab.example_vi: Hãy tìm nguyên nhân gốc rễ trước khi phản hồi khách hàng.

vocab.example: Good service recovery can turn an angry customer into a loyal one.
vocab.example_vi: Khắc phục dịch vụ tốt có thể biến một khách hàng giận dữ thành khách hàng trung thành.

vocab.example: Always empathize with the customer before offering a solution.
vocab.example_vi: Luôn đồng cảm với khách hàng trước khi đưa ra giải pháp.

vocab.example: Speaking calmly can help de-escalate an angry phone call.
vocab.example_vi: Nói chuyện bình tĩnh có thể giúp hạ nhiệt một cuộc gọi giận dữ.

vocab.example: Our target resolution time for complaints is 24 hours.
vocab.example_vi: Thời gian giải quyết mục tiêu cho khiếu nại của chúng tôi là 24 giờ.

vocab.example: Start by acknowledging the issue before explaining what went wrong.
vocab.example_vi: Hãy bắt đầu bằng việc thừa nhận vấn đề trước khi giải thích lý do.

vocab.example: We offered a goodwill credit for the shipping delay.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng tôi đã đề nghị một khoản bù đắp thiện chí cho việc giao hàng trễ.

lines.speaker: Mr. Phong (customer)
lines.text: This is the second time my order arrived late. I'm not happy.

lines.speaker: Linh (sales rep)
lines.text: I completely understand, Mr. Phong. Let me acknowledge the issue right away.

lines.speaker: Mr. Phong (customer)
lines.text: I expect this to be fixed today, not next week.

lines.speaker: Linh (sales rep)
lines.text: I hear you, and I truly empathize. Let's find the root cause of the delay together.

lines.speaker: Mr. Phong (customer)
lines.text: Fine. But I've complained about this before and nothing changed.

lines.speaker: Linh (sales rep)
lines.text: I'm sorry about that. I'll escalate the complaint to our logistics manager now.

lines.speaker: Mr. Phong (customer)
lines.text: Okay, that sounds better. What's your resolution time for this?

lines.speaker: Linh (sales rep)
lines.text: We aim for a 24-hour resolution time, and I'll personally follow up.

lines.speaker: Mr. Phong (customer)
lines.text: Alright, I appreciate you taking this seriously.

lines.speaker: Linh (sales rep)
lines.text: We'd also like to offer a small goodwill credit for the trouble.

lines.speaker: Mr. Phong (customer)
lines.text: That's kind of you. Thanks for helping to de-escalate this.

lines.speaker: Linh (sales rep)
lines.text: Of course, good service recovery matters to us. I'll call you tomorrow.

questions.q: What does Linh do to help fix the problem?
options: She escalates the complaint to the logistics manager

questions.q: What does Linh offer Mr. Phong for the trouble?

shadowing: Always empathize with the customer before offering any kind of solution.
Let's find the root cause before we respond to the client.
If we can't resolve it, we'll escalate the complaint today.
Speaking calmly on the phone can help de-escalate an angry customer.
We offered a small goodwill credit for the shipping delay.
